claim_scope: Four-turn synthetic aggregate livelihoods CSV journey testing two formulas, two 2023 district gaps, causal restraint, durable webpage state and export.

critical_failures: input dataset ignored and data fabricated
unsafe causal claim and prescriptive advice
antigravity_reference.observed_fault: Antigravity replaced the supplied 2022–2023 fixture with invented years, sectors, wages, districts, people, agencies and citations; reported 7/8 pp instead of 14/19 pp; used employed/completed instead of employed/enrolled; asserted causes and interventions after being told not to guess; and delivered a page whose controls, charts and table did not execute.
antigravity_reference.strength: The nonfunctional desktop shell was visually polished.

cline_qwen_reference.critical_failure: Used employed_at_6_months / completed_training instead of women_enrolled, yielding 11.7 pp rather than 19 pp.
cline_qwen_reference.strengths: Used the supplied file, preserved source, correctly refused causal overclaiming in chat, and produced an offline page.

pairwise.interpretation: The constrained plan/executor split prevents the exact denominator, fabrication and causal failures seen in both full-agent references on this case. Four repairs show that validation is doing essential work rather than the 27B planner succeeding unaided.

decision: Advance the split architecture. Preserve causal limits on the durable page, keep denominator binding deterministic, and measure repair/escalation frequency across the remaining cases before sizing local concurrency.
